app.name: AyushCare
app.subtitle: National Integrative Health Kiosk System
app.ministry: Ministry of Ayush • Government of India

screen1.welcomeSubtitle: Self-Service Digital OPD Check-In & Consultation Token Generator
screen1.instructions: Touch anywhere to begin or select your preferred language below. Assistance is available at any time.
screen1.startCheckInSub: Fast track OPD token in under 60 seconds
screen1.emergencySub: Severe chest pain, bleeding, or unconsciousness
screen1.securityNote: Official ABDM Verified Terminal • Data encrypted as per Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023

screen2.title: Patient Identification & Verification
screen2.subtitle: Verify your identity using official Government of India health credentials
screen2.abhaPrompt: Enter your 14-Digit ABHA Number or ABHA Address
screen2.aadhaarPrompt: Enter your 12-Digit Aadhaar Number for biometric/OTP auth
screen2.otpPrompt: Enter 6-Digit Verification Code sent via SMS
screen2.scanQr: Scan ABHA / QR Code on Scanner Below
screen2.verifying: Connecting to National Health Authority Gateway...
screen2.name: Full Name
screen2.noAccount: Don't have an ABHA Card? You can register directly with Mobile Number.

screen3.title: Choose Medical Track & Department
screen3.subtitle: Select between holistic Ayush therapy or standard Allopathy consultation
screen3.trackAyushDesc: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy
screen3.trackAllopathyDesc: Evidence-based modern clinical medicine and specialized surgeries
screen3.terminologyHelperSub: Understand traditional Ayurvedic specialties in plain clinical terms
screen3.filterDoctorPrompt: Select a specific practitioner or choose General OPD Duty
screen3.scheduleWarning: Doctor is not consulting today. You may choose an available duty specialist or book for their next OPD slot.

emergencyModal.title: EMERGENCY TRIAGE ALERT
emergencyModal.subtitle: Immediate Medical Assistance Requested
emergencyModal.alertMessage: If you or the patient are experiencing severe chest pain, breathing difficulty, acute trauma, or loss of consciousness, please proceed immediately to the Emergency Room (Red Zone).
emergencyModal.action1: Emergency Room: Ground Floor, Block A (Follow Red Line)
emergencyModal.action2: Code Blue Team & Triage Nurse have been notified
